purpose: Teach: ミッキー/ウィリアムズ/クック/ヘレン/ダビデ/ケイト/トミー/メリー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ディズニーのミッキー好きだったな
lines.en: Riku — you actually liked Mickey Mouse from Disney, didn't you?
lines.style: Teasing lilt at the start. Warm accusation — she's caught him in something innocent. Slight smile in the voice, the rhythm of old banter between people who know each other well.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テニスのウィリアムズ姉妹好きだったろ、桜
lines.en: You liked the Williams sisters in tennis though, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick, almost defensive volley back. Not wounded — energised by the back-and-forth. Light on 「好きだった」, like he's turning her own logic on her. A small grin underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で探検家ジェームズ・クックの名前覚えたな
lines.en: Riku — you memorised that stuff about Captain Cook from social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Pressing the advantage now, building the rhythm. Eyes bright with the fun of having proof. Slightly slower on the reference, like she's savouring catching him in the act.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語の教科書でヘレン・ケラー読んだろ、桜
lines.en: You read about Helen Keller in your English textbook though, Sakura.
lines.style: Calm counter-strike. Not rattled — matching her pace and rhythm exactly. The tone of someone who's studied her well enough to have ammunition ready. Quiet confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でダビデ像の写真覚えたな
lines.en: Riku — you definitely memorised that photo of Michelangelo's David from social studies.
lines.style: Building momentum. The accusation lands with more weight this time — she's not waiting for his answer, just stating the fact. Quick, sharp, convinced.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英王室のケイト妃のニュース見たろ、桜
lines.en: You watched that news story about Kate Middleton and the royal family though, Sakura.
lines.style: Even steadier now. Not defensive anymore — just matching her move for move with the same easy certainty. The rhythm has become almost musical between them.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、トミー・ジョンの肩の手術調べてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were actually looking into Tommy John surgery and all that, weren't you?
lines.style: Landing harder on this one. She's moved past teasing into something more specific — she really did catch him on this. The tone shifts slightly more serious underneath the playfulness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族でメリー・ポピンズの映画観たろ、桜
lines.en: You watched Mary Poppins with your family though, Sakura.
lines.style: Final volley, delivered with quiet satisfaction. He's saved the best for last — the most domestic, most vulnerable of all her catches. Spoken gently, almost affectionately. The rhythm slows just slightly.
